title: Quick check: View Transitions

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “View Transitions”?
options: The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
The <ViewTransition /> component should use semantics and focus/keyboard behavior that assistive technology can observe.
questions.answer_key: The <ViewTransition /> component should use semantics and focus/keyboard behavior that assistive technology can observe.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in View Transitions: The <ViewTransition /> component should use semantics and focus/keyboard behavior that assistive technology can observe.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying The <ViewTransition /> component?
options: Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Test keyboard use, accessible names, focus order, and semantic controls.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
questions.answer_key: Test keyboard use, accessible names, focus order, and semantic controls.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in View Transitions: Test keyboard use, accessible names, focus order, and semantic controls.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “View Transitions” complete?
options: Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in View Transitions: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
